import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Create the visualization
# Using seaborn.catplot to show the mean survival rate by Pclass and Sex
g = sns.catplot(
    data=df,
    x='pclass',
    y='survived',
    hue='sex',
    kind='bar',
    palette='coolwarm',  # 'coolwarm' palette is good for distinguishing categories
    errorbar='sd',       # Show standard deviation as error bars
    height=6,            # Height of the plot
    aspect=1.2           # Aspect ratio of the plot
)

# Set titles and labels
g.set_axis_labels("Passenger Class", "Survival Rate")
g.set_titles("Survival Rate on Titanic by Passenger Class and Sex")
g._legend.set_title("Sex") # Set the legend title

# Map numerical pclass values to descriptive strings for better readability on x-axis
pclass_labels = {1: 'First Class', 2: 'Second Class', 3: 'Third Class'}
# Access the axes object directly from the FacetGrid and set xticklabels
for ax in g.axes.flat:
    ax.set_xticks(list(pclass_labels.keys())) # Ensure ticks are at the correct positions
    ax.set_xticklabels(list(pclass_labels.values()))

# Adjust y-axis limits to start from 0 and end at 1 for survival rate clarity
g.set(ylim=(0, 1))

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
